title: Thule Society seances to contact star beings

tellings.quote: The Thule Society held seances and rituals meant to contact non-human intelligences they believed were their ancient progenitors, star beings from the far north, beneath the pole star.

plain: The Thule Society, a German occult group of the early 1900s, held seances and rituals to contact non-human intelligences that its members believed were their ancient ancestors: star beings from the far north, beneath the pole star. That is Michels's account, given in his own voice without naming a source. It matters to his larger story because it shows ideas about contact with beings from the stars running through German occult circles in the years before the Nazis.
